shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab/stele
horizontal register band across the upper part
row of repeated small motifs within the band
animal head shown in profile with open mouth
curved, hook-like limb or claw forms
figures set against a plain flat ground
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing flat low relief organised with a horizontal band of repeated small motifs across the top and larger profile creatures below, and both use a schematic outline style with the figures reserved against a plain ground. But the actual subjects differ: A shows elaborate anthropomorphic figures with plumed headdresses, scrolls and hand-held objects confronting one another, while B shows discrete animals (a beaked/snouted head, a long descending serpentine creature, a bird-like head with a round eye) with no human figures and no interaction between them.
